title: Measure
description: Output of `andon measure --json`: the flow, efficiency and counter metrics of one project's ledger over a period, derived from log.jsonl, issue.yaml, questions.yaml, report.json, gate records, corrections.json and GitHub's merged pull requests. Printed only; never written or kept. A count is 0 and a rate, mean or median is null when there is no record to count. Records that could not be read are listed in skipped, not counted as 0. Only these keys.

project.description: The project's slug (the folder that holds kanban/).

since.description: First day of the period, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: Last day of the period, included, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD.

flow.description: Flow: lead time, wait per state, questions open, throughput and WIP (Little's law).

lead_time.description: From the issue's creation to its pull request's merge, for pull requests merged in the period: count and median hours.

wait.description: Ledger status (every column but the last) -> issues that spent time in it during the period, and the mean hours each spent there. Reviewer issues are left out.

question_open.description: Questions open (asked, not yet answered) during the period: count and mean hours open within it.

closed.description: Issues moved to the last column in the period, and per day.

wip_end.description: Issues in progress (neither the first column, queued, nor the last) at the end of the period.

efficiency.description: Efficiency, per pull request merged in the period. Read next to counter.

merged_prs.description: Ledger pull requests (report.json pr) merged in the period.

human_touches.description: log.jsonl lines of those issues whose by is not terminal: or routine:, and per pull request (the primary metric).

per_pr.description: total / merged_prs; null when none merged.

auto_merge.description: Pull requests merged by the dispatcher (a gate record with merged true), and the rate among merged_prs.

rate.description: count / merged_prs; null when none merged.

gate.description: Gate records written in the period, and the send-back rate (fix + needs_human) / records.

counter.description: Counter metrics, read next to auto_merge: what gets worse if merging is made too easy.

reverted.description: Merged ledger pull requests reverted by a pull request merged in the period (title starts with Revert, body names owner/repo#n or the URL).

follow_ups.description: Issues created in the period whose links, or whose merged pull request's body, hold the URL of another issue's merged pull request.

reopened.description: Reopened by the person, per gate tier: issues with one or more corrections among merged_prs, and dispatcher-merged pull requests reverted in the period.

corrections.description: recorded: the ledger has a corrections.json. none: no record yet, so the corrections part is not counted.

by_tier.description: Tier of the merged gate record, else of the latest gate record; none when there is no gate record.

corrected.description: Issues among merged_prs with one or more corrections (corrections.json), per gate tier. Unlike reopened, reverts are not counted.

corrections.description: recorded: the ledger has a corrections.json. none: no record yet, so the corrections part is not counted.

by_tier.description: Tier of the merged gate record, else of the latest gate record; none when there is no gate record.

prs.description: The ledger pull requests merged in the period, one each, by issue id.

skipped.description: Records not counted because they could not be read: a log.jsonl line, a file, or a repository whose merged pull requests could not be listed.

rate.description: Two decimals, or null when the denominator is 0.

stat.description: How many were counted, and hours (mean or median, two decimals; null when count is 0).

hours.description: Hours, or null when count is 0.

pr.description: One merged pull request of the ledger.

merged_at.description: When GitHub merged it, UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

tier.description: Gate tier (see counter.reopened.by_tier), none when there is no gate record.

human_touches.description: log.jsonl lines of the issue by the person.

lead_time_hours.description: From the issue's creation to the merge; null when the creation time is unknown.

reverted.description: Reverted by a pull request merged in the period.

corrections.description: The issue's corrections.json has one or more entries.

source.description: Path relative to the project (kanban/log.jsonl, kanban/issues/<id>/...), or github.com/<owner>/<repo>.

line.description: Line number in a log.jsonl, 1 or more.
